job.title: [Post] Hiring: Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant Location: Austin, TX or San Fra…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant | Java, Spring, OCC APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend specialist with 5+ years delivering end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and OCC REST APIs, with proven success designing PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, data pipelines and API migrations. Strong techno-functional consultant: elicits business requirements, writes user stories, maps processes and guides international stakeholders through delivery, all within Agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am drawn to your vision of accelerating digital commerce for global enterprises, and the Senior Functional Consultant role aligns perfectly with my background. Over the past five years I have led SAP Commerce Cloud implementations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, delivering robust, scalable e-commerce platforms that drive measurable business value.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product catalog, pricing and order management, ensuring platform stability and performance.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST services and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, integrating SAP ERP and MDM systems across continents.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Business Analysis
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to elicit requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and translate them into technical designs that met compliance and user-experience goals.

bullets.label: Leadership & Delivery
bullets.text: Mentored junior developers, performed code reviews, and drove CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, consistently meeting sprint commitments in Agile teams.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: I admire your commitment to building next-generation commerce experiences that blend data-driven insights with seamless customer journeys. Your focus on innovative, cloud-native SAP Commerce solutions resonates with my passion for delivering high-impact, integrated platforms. Joining your team would allow me to apply my deep Hybris expertise and techno-functional consulting skills to help your clients accelerate digital transformation and achieve measurable growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: Eager to leverage my 5+ years of SAP Commerce (Hybris) expertise to drive innovative, integrated e-commerce solutions for your global clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant with 5+ years delivering integrated e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’d love to discuss how I can add value to your team. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Consultant position. I bring over five years of hands-on experience with SAP Commerce Cloud, API integration and techno-functional consulting. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
